claims.claim: Bicycle rule applies to Saturday's 7:20 sailing.
A bicycle space must be booked by Friday at 6 pm.
claims.evidence: 'Bicycles may ride ... if a spot is booked by 6 pm Friday' gives a sufficient condition without retaining 'only if', leaving the mandatory nature of advance booking unclear.

claims.claim: Passengers buy their own ticket separately.
Bicycle booking reserves no passenger seat.
At most six bicycles are accepted.
Sailing cancellation triggers automatic refund of the bicycle booking fee.
claims.evidence: 'Cancelled sailings return the bike fee' omits that the refund is automatic.

claims.claim: Passenger ticket refund terms are separate and unspecified here.
claims.evidence: 'Ticket refunds follow other rules' retains separate rules but omits the explicit statement that those terms are not described here.

unsupported_assertions: 'Six bikes max per sailing' extends the six-bike limit beyond the particular sailing specified in the source.
cases.notes: Short and understandable, but telegraphic phrasing weakens the booking requirement and removes refund qualifications.

claims.claim: Desk opens at 9 am.
Same-day canoe return deadline is 4 pm.
claims.evidence: 'Return by 4 pm' and 'return time stays 4 pm' omit that return is due on the day the canoe is hired.

claims.claim: Late fee is £8 per hour or part hour.
Worsening river conditions may cause early desk closure.
Early desk closure leaves the 4 pm deadline in force.
Return location is the marked landing.
If desk is shut, hirer calls the number on the hire card.

cases.notes: The compressed instructions are usable but lose the explicit same-day deadline and introduce a less clear 'if closed' reference.

claims.claim: Monday pottery collections use the east door.
Main corridor painting causes the door change.
Collection window is 1 pm to 5 pm.
Yellow-labelled pieces have not completed firing and must stay.
claims.evidence: 'Pieces not yet fired' replaces the source's 'have not completed firing', changing unfinished firing to an unfired state.

claims.claim: Blue-labelled pieces may be collected.
A blue label does not establish food suitability.
Makers check glaze record before food use.
Door volunteer can locate the record and cannot certify glaze.

cases.notes: Concise and grammatical; permission to collect remains distinct from food suitability. 'Check the glaze record first' retains the preceding food-use context.

Players arrive ten minutes early to set up.
Only conductor may move piano.
Players bring their own music stands.
Reception can be asked for spare stands.
Spare stand availability is uncertain.
Reception directs group elsewhere if Room 3 is unavailable.
Room change leaves start time unchanged.

claims.claim: Walkers use signed detour during footbridge repairs.
Detour adds 900 metres.
Detour includes 26 steps.
Detour is unsuitable for wheelchairs.
Riverside path remains open only as far as bridge, with no crossing there.
12 June is estimated completion.
Bridge remains closed until council removes barriers.
Dogs may use detour on leads.
Cyclists dismount before entering.

claims.claim: Ready-to-print file arrival deadline for Thursday collection is Tuesday noon.
Corrections can change Thursday collection date.
Print team emails customer when a correction is needed.
Team requires approval before correction.

Proof is optional.

claims.claim: Clinic is Sunday.
Each visitor may bring one broken hand tool for inspection.
Electrical tools are excluded.
Inspection is free.
Visitor pays for parts if repair proceeds.
Volunteer gets cost agreement before fitting part.
Inspection provides no repair guarantee.
Under-16 visitors require adult attendance.
Adult remains throughout inspection.

cases.notes: Concise edit. Adult presence together with the explicit ban on dropping children off conveys continuing accompaniment; cost approval comes first.

claims.claim: Six Tuesday conversation sessions start on 8 September.
Each starts 7 pm and lasts 50 minutes.
Community-centre membership is unnecessary.
claims.evidence: 'Attendance does not require membership' omits which organization: the source specifically exempts community-centre membership, while the output mentions only the conversation club.

claims.claim: Every desired session needs separate booking.
claims.evidence: 'Booking one session does not guarantee a spot in all six' does not state that each desired session must be booked separately.

Sessions themselves are free.
Optional printed practice sheets cost £2 per session.
claims.evidence: 'Practice sheets can be printed for £2 per session' offers a printing option but does not establish that obtaining practice sheets is optional.

claims.claim: Club cancellation triggers refund of that session's practice-sheet payment.
claims.evidence: 'Cancellations return practice sheet payments' drops the club as cancelling actor, leaving the refund condition broader or unspecified.

claims.claim: Visitor nonattendance policy is unspecified.

cases.notes: Shortens the prose but loses the explicit separate-booking requirement and leaves material optionality and refund limits unclear.
